SELECT u.user_idx, u.user_id, u.user_email, u.password_enabled, u.email_verified, u.email_login_enabled, u.account_status, u.user_role, u.nickname, u.nationality, u.preferred_lang, u.created_at, u.status_changed_at, IFNULL(s.social_count, 0) AS social_count, s.linked_providers, h.last_login_at, h.last_login_method, IFNULL(h.login_success_count, 0) AS login_success_count, IFNULL(h.login_fail_count, 0) AS login_fail_count
ORDER BY
h.last_login_at u.nickname u.created_at
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.*, IFNULL(s.social_count, 0) AS social_count, s.linked_providers, h.last_login_at, h.last_login_method, IFNULL(h.login_success_count, 0) AS login_success_count, IFNULL(h.login_fail_count, 0) AS login_fail_count FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_idx, COUNT(*) AS social_count, GROUP_CONCAT(provider ORDER BY provider) AS linked_providers FROM USER_SOCIAL GROUP BY user_idx ) s ON u.user_idx = s.user_idx LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_idx, MAX(login_at) AS last_login_at, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(login_method ORDER BY login_at DESC),',',1) AS last_login_method, SUM(CASE WHEN is_success=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_fail_count FROM USER_LOGIN_HISTORY GROUP BY user_idx ) h ON u.user_idx = h.user_idx WHERE u.user_idx = #{userIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET account_status = #{status}, status_changed_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
UPDATE USERS SET user_role = #{role} WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalMembers, SUM(CASE WHEN account_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeMembers, SUM(CASE WHEN account_status = 'DORMANT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dormantMembers, SUM(CASE WHEN account_status = 'DELETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deletedMembers, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayNewMembers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_LOGIN_HISTORY WHERE is_success = TRUE AND DATE(login_at) = CURDATE()) AS todayLogins, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_LOGIN_HISTORY WHERE is_success = FALSE AND DATE(login_at) = CURDATE()) AS todayFailedLogins, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_idx) FROM USER_SOCIAL WHERE provider = 'KAKAO') AS kakaoLinked, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_idx) FROM USER_SOCIAL WHERE provider = 'NAVER') AS naverLinked, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_idx) FROM USER_SOCIAL WHERE provider = 'GOOGLE') AS googleLinked FROM USERS
